title: Star Equity Holdings to Present at Upcoming Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Star Equity Holdings's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://www.starequity.com/node/28571/pdf)


OLD GREENWICH, Conn., Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Star Equity Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: STRR and STRRP) ("Star" or the "Company"), a diversified holding company, announced today that its management team will present and host one-on-one meetings with investors at two upcoming conferences.


- **Virtual Sidoti Small Cap Conference: September 23 - 24, 2026.**
Star’s main presentation is scheduled for Thursday, September 24 at 9:15am ET. Investors can access the live presentation by clicking[here](https://sidoti.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_tf_2l4FyT2efXP1cCZ1bzA) .


- **Noble Capital Markets’ Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference: October 1-2, 2026.**
Star’s main presentation is scheduled for Thursday, October 1 at 11:00am ET. Attendees interested in viewing the live presentation can join directly by clicking[here](https://channelchek.cc/4xtLC5Y) .


Management will also host virtual one-on-one meetings with investors during both conferences.


Investors can download a PDF copy of the presentation by visiting Star’s Investor Relations section of the website[www.starequity.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HMylAz6U25v5-kE-p2SGIbzlLnsP3FZgvIfesN2DwRSzfCvhEu59Rs5APhAFqNCCe_TJkIrw-wyA13hLLzlhuPoaH0XYRQxJ9lE9fPv6lX0=) .


**About Star Equity Holdings, Inc.**


Star Equity Holdings, Inc. is a diversified holding company that seeks to build long-term shareholder value by acquiring, managing, and growing businesses with strong fundamentals and market opportunities. Its current structure comprises four segments: Building Solutions, Business Services, Energy Services, and Investments. For more information visit[www.starequity.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HMylAz6U25v5-kE-p2SGIYB9XNSyGQX-SLmMfmNgHD6cNIwUQM1-zPxhnnfU7jcVLSGP-3Vd8Sh3v3CGVnZ-lSCGE1p-f6UgfBJnoKCQ6Hg=) .


**Building Solutions**


The Building Solutions division operates in three specialties: (i) modular building manufacturing; (ii) structural wall panel and wood foundation manufacturing, including building supply distribution operations; and (iii) glue-laminated timber (glulam) column, beam, and truss manufacturing.


**Business Services**


The Business Services division provides flexible and scalable recruitment solutions to a global clientele, servicing organizations at all levels, from entry-level positions to the C-suite. The division focuses on mid-market and enterprise organizations worldwide, partnering consultatively with talent acquisition, HR, and procurement leaders to build diverse, high-impact teams and drive business success.


**Energy Services**


The Energy Services division engages in the rental, sale, and repair of downhole tools used in the oil and gas, geothermal, mining, and water-well industries.


**Investments**
The Investments division manages and finances the Company’s real estate assets as well as its investment positions in private and public companies.
